hook.en: A new car loses value fastest in its first year. The written down value method charges more depreciation in the early years and less later.
hook.kn: ಹೊಸ ಕಾರು ಮೊದಲ ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲೇ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಳಿಮುಖ ಬಾಕಿ ವಿಧಾನವು ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು, ನಂತರ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಸವಕಳಿ ವಿಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: A new car loses value fastest in its first year. The written down value method charges more depreciation in the early years and less later.
narration.kn: ಹೊಸ ಕಾರು ಮೊದಲ ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲೇ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಳಿಮುಖ ಬಾಕಿ ವಿಧಾನವು ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು, ನಂತರ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಸವಕಳಿ ವಿಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Depreciation is charged at a fixed rate on the book value (written down value) at the beginning of each year. Because the book value keeps falling, the amount of depreciation falls every year, and the asset never reaches zero. This method is accepted by the income tax authorities and suits assets like machinery whose repair costs rise with age.

points.en: Fixed rate on reducing book value

narration.en: Depreciation is charged at a fixed rate on the book value (written down value) at the beginning of each year. Because the book value keeps falling, the amount of depreciation falls every year, and the asset never reaches zero. This method is accepted by the income tax authorities and suits assets like machinery whose repair costs rise with age.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷದ ಆರಂಭದ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ಸ್ಥಿರ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸವಕಳಿ ವಿಧಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಸವಕಳಿ ಮೊತ್ತ ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದಾಯ ತೆರಿಗೆ ಇಲಾಖೆ ಈ ವಿಧಾನವನ್ನು ಒಪ್ಪುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Written down value method

say.en: Under WDV the rate is applied to the book value at the start of each year.
Year 2: ten percent of 90,000 is 9,000. Year 3: ten percent of 81,000 is 8,100.
The charge falls every year, and the book value never reaches zero.
Compare SLM at the same rate on cost: a straight line that hits zero in 10 years.
WDV keeps the total charge even: falling depreciation offsets rising repairs.

body.en: SLM: rate on original cost, equal amount every year, total charge (depreciation plus repairs) rises over time. WDV: rate on book value, decreasing amount, total charge stays more even because falling depreciation offsets rising repairs.

points.en: Base: original cost vs book value
Zero value possible vs never zero

narration.en: SLM: rate on original cost, equal amount every year, total charge (depreciation plus repairs) rises over time. WDV: rate on book value, decreasing amount, total charge stays more even because falling depreciation offsets rising repairs.

caption.en: WDV: book value = C(1 − r/100)^x, a curve that never reaches zero. SLM at the same rate on cost: C − C·r/100·x, a straight line.

narration.en: Compare how the two methods write down the same asset.

narration.en: Recap. WDV applies a fixed rate to the opening book value each year. The depreciation amount decreases every year. The book value never becomes zero. WDV is accepted by the income tax authorities.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಇಳಿಮುಖ ಬಾಕಿ ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷದ ಆರಂಭಿಕ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ಸ್ಥಿರ ದರ. ಸವಕಳಿ ಮೊತ್ತ ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಶೂನ್ಯವಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದಾಯ ತೆರಿಗೆ ಇಲಾಖೆ ಇಳಿಮುಖ ಬಾಕಿ ವಿಧಾನವನ್ನು ಒಪ್ಪುತ್ತದೆ.
